overview: The Medford Historic District Commission conducted an advisory review of a proposed multi-unit addition at 54 South Street and approved window alterations for 15 Hillside. The commission also reviewed progress on the South Street Historic District report and website updates.

items.title: 54 South Street Advisory Review
items.summary: The commission held an advisory discussion on plans for a multi-unit addition behind the historic Greek Revival structure at 54 South Street, with members expressing concern over the scale and massing of the addition relative to the original building.

items.title: 15 Hillside Window Alterations
items.summary: Approved an application to alter exterior windows at 15 Hillside, with a required modification to relocate the second-floor window rather than eliminate it.

items.title: Commission Business and Updates
items.summary: The chair provided updates on the proposed South Street Historic District report, commission website restoration, and plans to submit district guidelines for legal review.
